user.title: Add a Gouly controller
user.description: You need your controller's device ID and local key. The easiest way to get them is the gouly-keys tool, see the README.

menu_options.paste: Paste gouly_devices.json from the gouly-keys tool
menu_options.manual: Enter the device ID and local key manually

paste.title: Paste gouly_devices.json
paste.description: Paste the contents of the gouly_devices.json file created by gouly-keys. Home Assistant will find the controller on your network automatically; this can take up to a minute.

pick.title: Choose a controller
pick.description: The file lists several controllers. Add one now, then run this setup again for the others.

manual.title: Enter controller details
manual.description: Leave the IP address empty to scan your network for the controller; this can take up to a minute.

error.invalid_json: That doesn't look like gouly_devices.json. Paste the whole file.
error.invalid_local_key: The local key should be 16 characters long.
error.not_found: Couldn't find a controller that accepts this device ID and key. Check that the controller is powered on and on the same network as Home Assistant, and that the key is current (re-pairing the controller changes it).

abort.already_configured: This controller is already set up.
abort.not_found: Couldn't find a controller that accepts this device ID and key. Check that the controller is powered on and on the same network as Home Assistant, and that the key is current (re-pairing the controller changes it).
